question: Did restoring specs.py make one data root satisfy both issue_47_v1 and issue_28_v13, as the previous entry claimed?
answer: No. It removed specs.py from the divergent set and nothing else. requirement_profile.py, run_store.py and records.py still diverge, because the registration patch changes them and issue_47_v1 records the patched bytes. The earlier claim was read off the UNPATCHED repository tree, which is not the tree that runs historical Runs.
second_correction: The divergence is also not a cost this work introduced. Every generation in the installed data root records a different requirement_profile.py, run_store.py and records.py - 13, 11 and 9 distinct hashes across 14 generations. A code tree satisfying one generation at a time is the ratchet's standing shape.

what_is_now_true: specs.py: issue_47_v1 records the same bytes as issue_28_v13 and v14, in all three trees.
requirement_profile.py, run_store.py, records.py: issue_47_v1 records the patched bytes; issue_28_v13 and v14 record the unpatched ones. A code tree satisfies one or the other.
That was already true before this work and is true of every generation pair.

what_the_patched_tree_already_cannot_do.measured: tests/vnext/test_native_request_construction fails in the patched runtime tree with NATIVE_REQUEST_CONSTRUCTION_RULE_CHANGED:scripts/vnext/records.py, 4 failures and 12 errors of 13 cases
what_the_patched_tree_already_cannot_do.pre_existing: records.py has been in the registration patch since it was first written, for the point_in_time_fiscal_label hunk. The patched tree has therefore never been able to run the issue_28 continuous semantic-call route.
what_the_patched_tree_already_cannot_do.what_this_does_and_does_not_license: It means adding more routes to the patch does not newly break issue_28 in that tree. It does NOT mean version gating is unnecessary: an argument that a tree cannot run another generation anyway is not a substitute for code that says which generation it serves. Where the Requirement is in scope the route is gated on it; where it is not, capacity is resolved from the Spec identity the record declares and every other check is the frozen one, proven by differential comparison.
what_the_patched_tree_already_cannot_do.correction: An earlier argument in this session said issue_28_v13 and v14 could not even load in the patched tree. Measured: they load. Requirement snapshots load; it is the request-construction scope's own byte pins that fail.
